{{MultipleIssues|citation|cleanup}}
{{Youmay|a type of projectile weapon|''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]''}}
[[File:Slugthrowers_on_Onderon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Primitive slugthrowers were used to defend [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].]]
{{Quote|Slugthrowers. I hate 'em. But they're easy to maintain. Day or two in the jungle and your blaster'll never fire again. A good slug rifle, keep 'em wiped and oiled, they last forever. The guerrillas have pretty good luck with them, even though they take a ''lot'' of practice—slugs are ballistic, y'know? You have to plot the trajectory in your head. Shee, gimme a blaster ''anytime''.|[[Phloremirlla Tenk]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
'''Slugthrowers''' were handheld projectile weapons that used an explosive chemical to launch a solid projectile (a "[[Slug/Legends|slug]]") at high velocity. [[Blaster/Legends|Blasters]] were fashioned in style and function after these more primitive weapons. Slugthrowers were found in various forms, from smaller [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistols]] to larger [[Slugthrower rifle/Legends|slugthrower rifles]].

==Description==
According to [[Phloremirlla Tenk]], slugthrowers also seemed to be a more rugged and reliable weapon than a blaster, stating that they "last forever", whereas blasters "never fire again" after "a day or two in the jungle".<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

As blaster usage increased, the popularity of personal armor declined&mdash;while extremely effective against most slugs, even modern armor could not stop a direct blaster hit, and as a result the wearing of bulky or cumbersome protective gear seemed to offer little benefit, while still obstructing movement. Thus, the blaster arguably ''increased'' the usefulness of the slugthrower.<ref name="The Star Wars Sourcebook">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:TuskenRecon-TSS.png|thumb|left|250px|A Tusken Raider armed with a cycler rifle]]
[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] was a large manufacturer of slugthrowers, throughout its history. Other manufacturers included [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] and [[Oriolanis Defense Systems/Legends|Oriolanis]].

[[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]], who would become the infamous [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]], [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]], used a slugthrower rifle during the [[Huk War]].

In the [[Summertime War]] before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] natives of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] used slugthrowers because [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] became ineffective in the Haruun Kal jungle.

[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] used the [[Cycler rifle/Legends|Tusken Cycler]] as a long range weapon when they were not close enough to use [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]]. Most Slugthrower projectiles could penetrate a [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper's]] helmet lens or vulnerable neck area, so when stormtroopers arrived on Tatooine, Tuskens often used them as target practice.

Several Rebel detachments carried slugthrowers, including [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForce]] units, who preferred them because of the ability to silence them. Many used special explosive ammunition that was especially effective against stormtrooper armor. The [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]] carried them at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had old fashioned slug throwers hidden in his bunk in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with several other highly illegal weapons.<ref name="COURT">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

[[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] famously carried a slugthrower along with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] also was known to carry a slugthrower pistol as of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] and used it to distract Bastion security during the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] while helping [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

Slugthrowers were one of the more common weapons in the remote planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], because [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and replacements for them were hard to find. There was an annual [[Landing Shootout]] in the capital town of [[Bartyn's Landing]] where contestants shot their slugthrowers to static targets for fame and awards, with the first award being a pearl-incrusted slugthrower handcrafted by artisan and crack shot [[Mix Liddell]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref><ref name="Reckonings">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
